The general statement 'All GIS data are in Robinson ... meters' is not true of shapefile geometry. Per-file .prj declares geographic degrees. No harmonization applied.

Proprietary ArcMap display documents cannot be fully interpreted here. Original bytes preserved; format is not Word despite Drive MIME labels. No claim of complete extraction of ArcGIS rendering or layout semantics.
Drive labels .spx as audio/ogg and .mxd as application/msword. In this archive these are GIS spatial indexes and ArcMap documents, respectively. Supplied MIME and inferred formats both retained.
